clue.text: Cook very sour northern delicacy

explanation.surface: An instruction to cook something very sour that is a speciality of the north.
explanation.walkthrough: Bakewell is a town in Derbyshire, in the north Midlands of England, and its almond and jam pastry is famous.
explanation.definitionFit: The pastry is named after a Derbyshire town, so it is a regional speciality of northern England.

clue.text: Black, freezing cold, the French boneshaker

C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
le is the French for 'the'

explanation.surface: A description of a black, ice-cold, French old machine.
explanation.definitionFit: Boneshaker was the nickname for early pedal cycles with hard tyres and rigid frames.

clue.text: Snorkel pipe blocked by seaweed

explanation.definitionFit: Kelp is a large brown seaweed, so this is a straightforward example-to-class synonym.

clue.text: Bird and funny individual dog

explanation.surface: A bird appears together with a comic character and a pet dog.

explanation.definitionFit: The wagtail is a small songbird known for bobbing its long tail.

clue.text: Article removed by paparazzo caught in Naples misbehaving

clue.text: Picked up tie or gear for dancing

clue.text: Exchange two cloths

clue.text: Ban renegade dodgy American meat supplier

clue.text: Sweet new bride hung over — dress torn away at the top

clue.text: Support Left over good work still to be done

clue.text: Mark flat jotter

a pad is a flat or apartment

clue.text: Youngster starts to feel awkward with nanny

indicators.note: starts means the opening letters of each of the following words

clue.text: Require broadcast work with dough

indicators.note: broadcast means spoken on air, so we hear the word

parts.note: to require is to need

explanation.surface: A broadcast says baking calls for working the dough.
explanation.definitionFit: Kneading is pressing and folding bread dough with the hands.

explanation.definitionFit: Something eternal lasts for ever, so it has no end.

clue.text: "High table" dish, starter from Aston University

explanation.surface: A dish served at a college high table, plus a first course from Aston University.

explanation.definitionFit: A plateau is an area of high level ground, so it is literally a high, flat table of land.

clue.text: Provide commentary barking arrant nonsense at the end

only the final letter of nonsense is used

explanation.surface: A commentator talks complete, absolute rubbish.

explanation.definitionFit: To narrate is to give a spoken account, as a commentator does.

clue.text: Replay gag about Mike Atherton's debut

clue.text: Sanction flying drones, the latest from Ukraine

clue.text: Natter with boring mate back in snug

clue.text: Freddie regularly visits downmarket eatery in the city

clue.text: Unfeeling note initially upset my brother

indicators.note: initially means the opening letters of each of the following words

explanation.definitionFit: Numb means deprived of feeling or sensation.

clue.text: Shoulder or stomach

clue.text: Ink manufacturer having month off work

parts.note: an octopus produces ink
Oct is the abbreviation for October

clue.text: France given its island data

parts.note: F is the international code for France

explanation.surface: France supplied with information about one of its islands.
explanation.definitionFit: A file is a stored collection of data.

clue.text: Amphora (pot) put back outside, being of decent quality

the answer is cut from the outer parts of the three words, around the bracketed pot

explanation.definitionFit: Up to par means reaching the expected standard, from golf's par score.
